data.one_liner: Tracks app version and prompts users to update via Play/App Store
data.what_it_does: It checks the current app version against a minimum version defined in a backend or Firebase Remote Config. If an update is available it can force or suggest the user to update the app.
use_when: You need to enforce a minimum app version for security or feature reasons
You want to offer optional or mandatory update prompts on Android and iOS
You need to track version history for onboarding or migrations
avoid_when: You only need a simple in-app update check without backend integration
You prefer a lightweight solution without external dependencies
strengths: Easy to integrate with both Android and iOS
Customizable via API or Firebase Remote Config
Tracks version history for analytics or migrations
weaknesses: Depends on several external packages (in_app_update, upgrader, version_tracker)
Requires Firebase setup if using the Firebase backend
May add extra weight to the app
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, configure Firebase if using that backend, provide app store IDs, and call AppVersioning.initialise in main.
